item.title: Community Voices: Friends of Big Morongo Canyon Preserve Are Looking for New Board Members - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: Friends of Big Morongo Canyon Preserve is led by a board of directors actively working at the preserve with their “boots on the ground”—and they are now accepting applications for two board positions.

item.title: Giving Groceries: Despite the Government Shutdown, Expiring Insurance Tax Credits and Inflation, Local Senior Centers Have Stepped Up to Keep Providing Food to Those in Need - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: When the Trump administration threatened to suspend SNAP and WIC benefits during the federal government shutdown late in 2025, local food programs responded with more outreach and information. Donors and corporate sponsors also stepped up.

item.title: Back, and Better: After Releasing an EP, Saving Slytherin Disappeared—but the Band Has Returned With Their Debut Album - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: The group released their debut album, Saving Slytherin Vol. 1, in late February, adding to their established genre blend with a mix of folky tunes that navigate feel-good reggae-pop vibes.

item.title: The Weekly Independent Comics Page for March 19, 2026! - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: Topics addressed this week include golf tournaments, profits, fluffy towels, infidels—and more!

item.title: Hiking With T: Four Hikes With Amazing Scenery, Wildlife and Spring Blooms - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: Whether you’re seeking a gentle nature walk or a strenuous bucket‑list climb, you’re sure to find it here in the Coachella Valley. Here are a few you should know about, if you don’t already.

item.title: Punk Over Posh: Palm Desert’s Damaged Goods Punk Shop Celebrates a Year in Business With a Party Featuring, Art, Music and More - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: Damaged Goods Punk Shop in Palm Desert has been providing threads, jewelry and more for the local alternative scene since late March 2025, and to commemorate the anniversary, the shop will host Damaged Fest, an event intertwining an art gallery experience with sets from energetic rockers.

item.title: Locked and Loaded: Jackyl Brings Their Head-Banging yet Blues-y Songs to Agua Caliente Rancho Mirage - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: Jackyl are slated to perform on Thursday, March 26, at Agua Caliente Rancho Mirage. It’ll be yet another date for the band whose Instagram bio proudly claims “ALWAYS ON TOUR!”

item.title: One Woman: Yo Younger and Gary Powers Offer a Theater Master Class in Revolution Stage’s ‘JBKO’ - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: As JBKO, Yo Younger inhabits the character and provides a nuanced, heart-felt portrait of a woman who is privileged, but—like all of us—has to deal with the ups and downs of life.

item.title: A True Cinema Event: ‘Project Hail Mary’ Is the Epic Sci-Fi-Charmer Movie Theaters Needed - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: The film starts with Ryan Gosling’s scientist and schoolteacher, Ryland Grace, waking up on a spaceship. As his memory slowly returns, he realizes he’s on a mission to save the Earth from a sun-gobbling microbe that is dimming our star.

item.title: Mistreated Behind Bars: Activists Postpone a Ballot-Initiative Effort to Require More Oversight of Riverside County’s Jails - Coachella Valley Independent
item.description: Last November, several Riverside County groups announced they'd be working to put a plan to place an independent sheriff’s oversight committee initiative on the 2026 ballot. That effort has stalled, at least for now.
